name: Margin drives against a wall
summary: Alone at a wall, rally drives above a tape line with a safety margin and count unforced errors per 50 shots.
setup: Tape a line on the wall about 1.2 m above the floor (above net height, the safety margin)
Stand about 5 m from the wall and rally controlled drives off one bounce, at a pace you can repeat
An error is a ball below the line, a mis-hit, or a ball you had time to reach but missed
Sets of 50 strokes; restart the rally after an error
success_criterion: In a set of 50 drives, at most 5 errors
coach_rationale: (judgment) Repeatable pace and a margin above the net cut unforced errors (AN-04); counting them per 50 shots makes the error rate visible with no partner or court. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
